newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria modernises coal mining complex.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria modernises coal mining complex.

text.p: Bulgaria, dependent on its biggest Maritsa East coal mines for 30 percent of its power needs, will open on Tuesday part of a new $90-million technical complex, energy officials said on Monday.
The new complex which will be equipped with modern machines, some of them made in Germany and the Czech Republic, will help in opening new coal mines, the energy ministry said in a statement.

The first stage of the complex, which includes excavators, trucks and a transporting system, has been built with Maritsa East mines' own funds and the help of a 1.5 billion lev credit from the State Fund for Reconstruction and Development.
Maritsa East, 250 km south-east of Sofia, has only lignite coal and its reserves of some two billion tonnes are expected to feed the country's coal-fired power stations for another 80 to 100 years.
